evals.expected_output: Should identify Shotgun Surgery (Severe — adding a field to User requires changes in model, DTO, mapper, validator, repository = 5 files minimum; the User concept is scattered). Should trace the hypothetical change: 'Adding a phoneNumber field requires editing user.model.ts, user.dto.ts, user.mapper.ts, user.validator.ts, user.repository.ts plus any tests'. Should recommend consolidating the thin DTO/Mapper layers or using a code-generation approach, and note that the role string literal type in validator duplicates the union type in the model.

Should identify Parallel Inheritance Hierarchies (Severe — XxxNotification and XxxHandler grow in lockstep; adding 'slack' notifications requires new SlackNotification + SlackHandler + updating dispatcher union type + updating if/else chain = 4 files). Should recommend merging handler behavior into the notification classes themselves (each notification knows how to send itself), or using a registration-based dispatcher. Should trace the concrete change: 'Adding Slack notifications currently requires touching 4 files; after refactoring, 1.'
